name: vibechat
description: Vibe Chat — Telegram Mini App for meeting new people (server, mini app, admin panel)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/server install && npm --prefix apps/miniapp install && npm --prefix apps/admin install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/server run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/miniapp run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/admin run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/server run build && npm --prefix apps/miniapp run build && npm --prefix apps/admin run build
